purpose: Decorative paywall headline background; an illustrative room, not a customer testimonial or evidence of product performance.

The LEFT half must be very dark navy negative space, softly out of focus, with no objects or bright highlights, specifically to receive a large white serif headline in the actual app. All identifiable phone and cup detail belongs to the RIGHT half. Natural photographic light, tactile materials, sophisticated magazine quality, clean composition, realistic proportions, not a 3D render. No text, letters, logos, UI, borders, badges, watermarks, security icons, shields, or glowing effects. This is a background image, not a full app screenshot.
